translations.text: Woe to the person who reviles a cleric at the time of hearing the word of God: it is not the cleric who is reviled there, but the Son of Mary of the great churches.
Woe to him who reproaches a man in holy orders, who stands in the place of the perfect Christ; whether what is said there is true or false, its reward is hell.
A priest, though his voice be rough, like the dirt that is carried in a stream, provided he performs his canonical hours, washes away all his faults [?].
Take it upon yourself never to reproach a man in holy orders, though he should do you every evil; leave it to the Body that is in his hand.
A pure priest, O God, may he be a friend to me! His Mass carries to heaven, and it is no lie, nine hundred and ten souls.
The priest who will baptise you as well [?], do not revile him afterwards! Woe to the mouth that speaks against him, and to your son, O son, it is great woe.
